content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Worcester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's prerequisites—typically a secondary degree plus years of directed project work, or a four-year degree with fewer years required. Verify your background meets the standard before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, learn from active certified practitioners, and cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world applications. Finish all required contact hours before submitting your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing training, create a PMI account and submit your formal PMP® application, documenting your project experience and education. Pay the associated exam fee to PMI. Your application enters review; approval typically follows within days, granting you eligibility to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam at a testing center or online. Sit for the four-hour assessment covering initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning the PMP®, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or mentoring. Renew on schedule to keep your credential active and demonstrate ongoing expertise to your local job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
